source_observation: One combined pair turning toward viewer. Johnny left, face tilted up-right smiling at the mermaid above/right; top hat tilts back-left. Mermaid faces left, leaning toward him, long yellow hair flying right, cyan band, green top and tail, happy expression with profile eye visible. Her nearer arm rests across his shoulder/chest, far arm around back of his neck. His near arm wraps under her green waist and far arm supports her upper back; hands touch her rather than emerging through clothing. Her tail makes a long low crescent sweeping left with fin lifted at far left. Johnny's leftmost leg reaches back-left with raised heel, rightmost leg extends down-right, wide grounded stance, coat tails trail behind.
